The international bestseller.The number one bestseller in Mexico and America for almost two years, and subsequently a bestseller around the world, Like Water For Chocolate is a romantic, poignant tale, touched with moments of magic, graphic earthiness, bittersweet wit - and recipes. A sumptuous feast of a novel, it relates the bizarre history of the all-female De La Garza family. Tita, the youngest daughter of the house, has been forbidden to marry, condemned by Mexican tradition to look after her mother until she dies. But Tita falls in love with Pedro, and he is seduced by the magical food she cooks. In desperation Pedro marries her sister Rosaura so that he can stay close to her. For the next twenty-two years Tita and Pedro are forced to circle each other in unconsummated passion. Only a freakish chain of tragedies, bad luck and fate finally reunite them against all the odds.

description.value:
The bestselling phenomenon and inspiration for the award-winning film.

Earthy, magical, and utterly charming, this tale of family life in turn-of-the-century Mexico blends poignant romance and bittersweet wit.

This classic love story takes place on the De la Garza ranch, as the tyrannical owner, Mama Elena, chops onions at the kitchen table in her final days of pregnancy. While still in her mother’s womb, her daughter to be weeps so violently she causes an early labor, and little Tita slips out amid the spices and fixings for noodle soup. This early encounter with food soon becomes a way of life, and Tita grows up to be a master chef, using cooking to express herself and sharing recipes with readers along the way.
source: https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/47042/like-water-for-chocolate-by-laura-esquivel/

description.value:
Marilyn Forrest Steele : à lui seul, ce nom ouvre à la jeune héritière les portes de la haute société d’Atlanta. Courtisée, choyée, Marilyn se lasse d’être traitée comme une poupée fragile et irresponsable. Elle est adulte et, pour le prouver, elle s’est lancée un défi : devenir la collaboratrice de la célèbre romancière Lila Thorpe et gagner sa vie en toute indépendance.

Enthousiaste, Marilyn s’installe chez la vieille dae, sur les rives du lac Lanier. Mais il lui faut bien vite déchanter. Francis Thorpe, riche banquier et fils de Lila, lui témoigne aussitôt une inexplicable hostilité. Pourtant, il est de ces instants où la méfiance cède la place à un sentiment étrange, fragile, mais déjà inoubliable…
